SMS program terms

SMS terms & consent.

How DakyXTech collects permission to send you text messages, what we send, how often, and how to stop them at any time.

How you opt in Opt out & help Your privacy
  1. Home

01

The program

Program name: DakyXTech Customer Messages.
Sender: DakyXTech (Dakyworld), Kumasi, Ghana — dakyx.com.

We send text messages only to people who have asked us to. They are customer-care messages, and they cover:

  • Replies to an enquiry you sent us through our website, by email or by phone.
  • Confirmations and reminders for calls and meetings you booked with us.
  • Updates on a project or monthly plan you have with us.
  • Invoice and payment reminders for work you have bought from us.
  • Account and security notices for our products (Website Builder, Dakyworld OS).

We do not send promotional or marketing messages through this program, and we never text numbers we found, bought or were given by someone else.

02

How you opt in

You will only receive texts from us after you give consent in one of these ways. Consent is always optional and is never a condition of buying anything from us.

1. On our website contact form

Our contact form has an optional checkbox under the message field. It is unticked by default; you only receive texts if you tick it yourself. The exact wording beside it is:

Yes, I agree to receive text messages from DakyXTech about my enquiry, appointments, projects and invoices at the phone number above. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out at any time, HELP for help. Agreeing is optional and not a condition of buying anything. See our SMS terms and privacy policy.

When you tick it, we record the time, the page and the wording you agreed to alongside your enquiry.

2. Verbally, on a call with us

If you speak to us by phone or video call and give us your mobile number, we ask before we text you. The script we use is:

“Can we send you text messages at this number about your enquiry, appointments, project updates and invoices? Message frequency varies and message and data rates may apply. You can reply STOP at any time to opt out, or HELP for help. Our full SMS terms are at dakyx.com/sms-consent.”

We only text you if you say yes. We note the date, time and the person who took your consent on your customer record.

After you opt in, the first message we send confirms it:

DakyXTech: You’re subscribed to customer messages about your enquiry, projects and invoices. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.
03

Message frequency and cost

Message frequency varies with your enquiry or project — usually no more than 10 messages a month.

Message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile plan. DakyXTech does not charge for text messages.

Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

04

Opting out and getting help

To stop: reply STOP to any message (STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END and QUIT also work). You will receive one final message confirming you have been unsubscribed, and no more after that:

DakyXTech: You have been unsubscribed and will receive no further messages. Reply START to resubscribe.

For help: reply HELP to any message, or contact us directly:

DakyXTech: For help, email info@dakyx.com or call +233 545 950 611. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.

You can also ask us to stop by emailing info@dakyx.com or calling +233 545 950 611.

05

Your privacy

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent are excluded from all other sharing and will not be shared with any third party.

We share your number only with Twilio, the provider that delivers our messages, and only so it can deliver them. Everything else about how we handle your data is in our privacy policy, and our general terms are in our terms of service.
